verdict.rationale: Intel publishes a real per-SKU specifications page for the 285K. It lists max clock (up to 5.70 GHz), 36M cache, ECC memory support, supported AI frameworks and vPro eligibility, and Phoronix independently refers to DDR5-6400 as the rated memory speed for the Core Ultra 200S. However, the evidence shows only fragments of the spec sheet, while much of the product-family material is marketing language. Missing for 10: published power figures (base/turbo watts), full memory speed/capacity specs on the vendor sheet, AI TOPS figures, and stated test conditions for any metric.
